skill.name: wechat-official-account

displayName.zh: 公众号文章与数据查询

description.zh: 查询自己管理的公众号文章及其阅读、分享和收藏人数，也支持将 HTML 保存到草稿箱；需要账号 API 权限。
description.en: Read published articles and reader, share and favorite counts for an authorized WeChat account, or save HTML as a draft. API access is required.

skill.usageExample: 查询我的公众号上周发表的文章，看看哪篇阅读人数最多。
